entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-balance
entry.summary: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch. Exact install spec: @lmmzss/dsh-plugin-balance. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
